**Coaching note (80 words):**

When your opponent's king is on the back rank with limited escape squares, look for forcing checks that drive it into a mating net. Here, the Black king on c8 is trapped by its own rook on d8 and pawns. Rb8+ forces the king to capture (only legal move), then Qb7 is checkmate—the queen controls all escape squares. Notice how the pinned c7 pawn earlier was a clue that the back rank was weak. Always scan for back-rank mating patterns when the enemy king lacks flight squares.
